items.title: Italy-Vietnam Agreement on Food Safety and Public Health
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 26 NOV - As part of Italian Cuisine Week in Vietnam, a workshop titled “Food Safety: Framework and Prospects in Italy and the EU. Implications for Vietnam and Other Exporting Countries” was held today. The workshop, organized by the Italian Embassy in Vietnam at Casa Italia, focused on food safety, control systems, and the traceability of agri-food products, with an emphasis on the European and Vietnamese regulatory frameworks and opportunities for cooperation.
